title: Data Analytics — Beginner
description: Learn analytics fundamentals and core Excel skills for working with data.

sections.title: Analytics Fundamentals
sections.description: Understand how data analytics supports business decisions.
learning_objectives: Explain the role of analytics in business decisions
Distinguish descriptive, diagnostic, and predictive analytics

sections.title: Data Cleaning
sections.description: Identify and fix common data quality issues.
learning_objectives: Identify duplicates, blanks, and inconsistent formats

sections.title: Excel Essentials
sections.description: Learn the core Excel interface and data-entry skills.

sections.title: Excel Formulas & Functions
sections.description: Use formulas and functions to calculate and transform data.
learning_objectives: Write formulas using relative and absolute references

sections.title: Lookup Functions
sections.description: Retrieve matching data across ranges and tables.

sections.title: Charts & Basic Visualization
sections.description: Create charts that communicate data clearly.

title: Data Analytics — Intermediate
description: Summarize data with Pivot Tables and begin building reports in Power BI.

sections.title: Pivot Tables
sections.description: Summarize and explore large datasets interactively.
learning_objectives: Build a Pivot Table from raw data

sections.title: Power Query
sections.description: Transform and combine data using Power Query.
learning_objectives: Import and shape data with Power Query

sections.title: Power BI Fundamentals
sections.description: Build interactive reports using Power BI.

sections.title: DAX Fundamentals
sections.description: Write DAX formulas for calculations in Power BI.
learning_objectives: Use calculated columns vs measures appropriately

sections.title: KPIs & Business Analytics
sections.description: Define and track KPIs that matter to a business.
learning_objectives: Define meaningful KPIs for a scenario

sections.title: Advanced Data Visualization
learning_objectives: Use combo and advanced chart types
Apply visual best practices for dashboards

title: Data Analytics — Advanced
description: Design production-grade dashboards and apply advanced DAX and analytics practices.

sections.title: Advanced DAX
sections.description: Write advanced DAX for complex business calculations.

sections.title: Dashboard Design
sections.description: Design clear, effective, and actionable dashboards.
learning_objectives: Apply dashboard layout and hierarchy principles

sections.title: Advanced Power Query & Data Modeling
sections.description: Build robust data models for analytics.
learning_objectives: Design a star schema data model
Optimize query performance in Power Query

sections.title: Advanced Business Analytics
sections.description: Apply advanced analytical reasoning to business problems.
learning_objectives: Perform root-cause analysis of KPI shifts

sections.title: Analytics at Scale
sections.description: Apply analytics practices to larger, more complex datasets and reports.
learning_objectives: Manage refresh and performance for large models

sections.title: Production Reporting Practices
sections.description: Apply best practices for reports used in ongoing business operations.
